flags.summary: On price hesitation alone the offer descended through three unlisted tiers in about five minutes — EUR 5,160 for six months, then EUR 3,400 for three months, then a EUR 1,030 one-month trial — none of which is the stated $6,000/6mo or $9,000/12mo offer.
evidence: for the six months, I'll round it up by a couple of euros, because it's a weird number, it's 5,160 euros
We have a three-month and we have a one-month trial.
The three months in euros is 3,400 euro.
In dollars, just so you understand, it's 4k USD for three months, 6k for six months.
And then if you wanted to do one month as a trial, it would be a thousand euros for one month. Well, 1,030.
And then at the end of that month, you can continue. There's not going to be an extra. You just pay the balance of whichever one you wanted to do.

flags.summary: The rep offered to frame the invoice however needed so a personal coaching fee could be written off through the prospect's limited company, and cited a previous client for whom it was framed as a safety and injury prevention programme.
evidence: we do it a lot where we write it off for people, since you're a business owner, we can help you out with the tax stuff too. So we can frame the invoice in any way that you need, say, we'll save you a lot

I signed someone up a few days ago who owned restaurants in America... And we framed it as safety and injury prevention program, and it's always good when you write most of it off and it's almost free.
